raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
- [ ] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

## What does this PR do?

Add opt-in Liger RMSNorm through the new `ops/norm` layout.

Stacked on #8656; this is the RMSNorm-only successor to the corresponding part of #5438. It does not depend on the separate cross-entropy contribution.

`--transformer-impl local --normalization RMSNorm --use-liger` selects the adapter through `LocalSpecProvider`. Standard GPT block construction includes the decoder final norm, MTP norms and enabled Q/K norms. Other provider slots and cross entropy stay unchanged. Missing selected dependencies fail through `ops._backends.require`; unselected paths do not import Liger.

The adapter retains checkpoint keys, zero-centered gamma and sequence-parallel gradient marking. Kitchen, TE/inference norm providers and unsupported custom model builders are not silently replaced.

CI: the H100 ops, models and determinism-kernel buckets install `liger-kernel==0.8.5` with `--no-deps` in latest/dev runs on dev images. The shared export check fails before tests on a broken installation. The image's `IMAGE_TYPE` marker excludes LTS even when GitHub labels its recipe environment `dev`; runtime installation remains optional.

## Performance (Liger v0.8.5)

Measured on H100 80GB with **exact release `v0.8.5` (`1ab779f`)**, PyTorch 2.13.0.2+cu130, Triton 3.7.1 and TE 2.20.2.0+cu130. Times are median synchronized wall latency; lower is better.

**RMSNorm, forward + backward:** BF16, non-unit weights, nonconstant upstream gradients. 10 warmups, 3 x 50 samples. Single GPU with reused inputs (hot-cache measurement).

| Tokens | Hidden | Torch (ms) | Liger (ms) | Speedup vs Torch | TE (ms) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 128 | 4096 | 0.133 | 0.353 | 0.38x | 0.312 |
| 2048 | 4096 | 0.131 | 0.351 | 0.37x | 0.307 |
| 8192 | 4096 | 0.255 | 0.365 | 0.70x | 0.313 |
| 8192 | 8192 | 0.503 | 0.426 | 1.18x | 0.413 |

Liger beats Torch at the largest listed shape but regresses at the smaller shapes; TE is faster at every listed shape. This is not a generally faster default.

**Full-model ablation:** 32-layer Llama2-7B shape, H4096, FFN11008, vocab32K, BF16, batch1, TP8; only this PR's operation changes. Three independent process launches/backend, 5 warmups +20 steps/sequence, forward + backward without optimizer or CUDA graphs. Table latencies are medians of the three process medians; the last column shows paired trial ranges (positive = slower).

| Sequence | Native model (ms) | Liger-only model (ms) | Paired latency change |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 512 | 83.544 | 100.464 | +14.58% to +21.03% |
| 2048 | 84.253 | 99.744 | +17.01% to +21.75% |
| 4096 | 155.667 | 155.245 | -0.27% to -0.25% |

Short/medium-sequence eager training regresses; the long-sequence difference is small.

**Numerics:** the separate full-gradient diagnostic has BF16 relative-L2 differences of 2.92-5.37% versus native and approximately 1.31e-05 in FP32. These are not convergence-equivalence claims.

## Issue tracking

Related to #5488 and #5438. Retarget to `main` after #8656 lands, before merging.

## Code provenance

No external kernel source copied. The adapter calls the installed Liger API; installation guidance identifies v0.8.5 or a newer compatible version.

## Contribution process

- [x] Unit tests, model forward/backward parity, and registered bit-exact kernel replay coverage
- [ ] Dedicated functional-test recipe
- [x] Typing and user documentation
- [x] `tools/autoformat.sh` against `pull-request/8656`

Validated independently on H100, including TP=1/2 and sequence-parallel backward. Existing parent BERT fallback-type and typing diagnostics are unchanged.

Latest-release focused regression suite: **507 passed per rank on four GPUs** (Liger v0.8.5, locally built from the release tag).

+# Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+
+"""CPU-only regression coverage for the legacy GPT norm dispatch."""
+
+from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
+
+import pytest
+
+import gpt_builders
+from megatron.core.transformer.heterogeneous.heterogeneous_config import (
+    HeterogeneousTransformerConfig,
+)
+from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_block import TransformerBlockSubmodules
+from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_config import TransformerConfig
+
+
+def _config(**overrides):
+    options = dict(
+        num_layers=2,
+        hidden_size=32,
+        num_attention_heads=4,
+        normalization="RMSNorm",
+        transformer_impl="local",
+    )
+    return TransformerConfig(**(options | overrides))
+
+
+def _args(**overrides):
+    args = Mock(
+        spec=None,
+        yaml_cfg=None,
+        transformer_impl="local",
+        experimental_attention_variant=None,
+        num_experts=None,
+        heterogeneous_layers_config_path=None,
+        normalization="RMSNorm",
+        qk_l2_norm=False,
+        mtp_num_layers=None,
+    )
+    args.spec = None
+    for name, value in overrides.items():
+        setattr(args, name, value)
+    return args
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("config_source", ["explicit", "args", "yaml"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("use_liger", [False, True])
+def test_dense_builder_norm_routing(use_liger, config_source):
+    config = _config(use_liger=use_liger)
+    args = _args(yaml_cfg="config.yaml" if config_source == "yaml" else None)
+    block = TransformerBlockSubmodules(layer_specs=[], layer_norm=object)
+    with (
+        patch.object(gpt_builders, "GPTModel") as model,
+        patch.object(gpt_builders, "_get_transformer_layer_spec") as layer_spec,
+        patch.object(gpt_builders, "get_gpt_decoder_block_spec", return_value=block) as block_spec,
+        patch.object(gpt_builders, "core_transformer_config_from_args", return_value=config),
+        patch.object(gpt_builders, "core_transformer_config_from_yaml", return_value=config),
+    ):
+        result = gpt_builders.gpt_builder(
+            args,
+            pre_process=True,
+            post_process=True,
+            vp_stage=1,
+            config=config if config_source == "explicit" else None,
+        )
+
+    assert result is model.return_value
+    if use_liger:
+        layer_spec.assert_not_called()
+        block_spec.assert_called_once_with(
+            config,
+            use_transformer_engine=False,
+            normalization="RMSNorm",
+            qk_l2_norm=False,
+            vp_stage=1,
+        )
+        assert model.call_args.kwargs["transformer_layer_spec"] is block
+    else:
+        block_spec.assert_not_called()
+        layer_spec.assert_called_once_with(False, config)
+        assert model.call_args.kwargs["transformer_layer_spec"] is layer_spec.return_value
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("use_liger", [False, True])
+def test_local_layer_helper_forwards_liger(use_liger):
+    config = _config(use_liger=use_liger)
+    with patch.object(gpt_builders, "get_gpt_layer_local_spec") as local_spec:
+        result = gpt_builders._get_transformer_layer_spec(False, config)
+
+    assert result is local_spec.return_value
+    local_spec.assert_called_once_with(
+        config.num_moe_experts,
+        config.moe_grouped_gemm,
+        config.qk_layernorm,
+        config.multi_latent_attention,
+        config.experimental_attention_variant,
+        normalization=config.normalization,
+        use_kitchen=config.use_kitchen,
+        use_kitchen_attention=config.use_kitchen_attention,
+        kitchen_attention_backend=config.kitchen_attention_backend,
+        use_liger=use_liger,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("use_liger", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("unsupported", ["experimental", "heterogeneous"])
+def test_default_spec_support_is_unchanged_without_liger(use_liger, unsupported):
+    args = _args()
+    config = _config(use_liger=use_liger)
+    if unsupported == "experimental":
+        args.experimental_attention_variant = "dsa"
+        spec_name = "get_transformer_block_with_experimental_attention_variant_spec"
+    else:
+        args.heterogeneous_layers_config_path = "layers.json"
+        spec_name = "get_gpt_heterogeneous_layer_spec"
+    with (
+        patch.object(gpt_builders, "GPTModel") as model,
+        patch.object(gpt_builders, spec_name) as spec,
+    ):
+        if use_liger:
+            with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="standard local GPT specs"):
+                gpt_builders.gpt_builder(args, True, True, config=config)
+            spec.assert_not_called()
+            model.assert_not_called()
+        else:
+            gpt_builders.gpt_builder(args, True, True, config=config)
+            spec.assert_called_once()
+            assert model.call_args.kwargs["transformer_layer_spec"] is spec.return_value
+
+
+def test_liger_rejects_heterogeneous_config_without_args_path():
+    config = Mock(spec=HeterogeneousTransformerConfig, use_liger=True)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="heterogeneous specs"):
+        gpt_builders.gpt_builder(_args(), True, True, config=config)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("unsupported", ["experimental", "heterogeneous"])
+def test_custom_spec_owns_normalization(unsupported):
+    args = _args(spec="custom.spec")
+    if unsupported == "experimental":
+        args.experimental_attention_variant = "dsa"
+    else:
+        args.heterogeneous_layers_config_path = "layers.json"
+    with (
+        patch.object(gpt_builders, "GPTModel") as model,
+        patch.object(gpt_builders, "import_module") as import_spec,
+        patch.object(gpt_builders, "get_gpt_decoder_block_spec") as block_spec,
+    ):
+        gpt_builders.gpt_builder(args, True, True, config=_config(use_liger=True))
+
+    import_spec.assert_called_once_with("custom.spec")
+    block_spec.assert_not_called()
+    assert model.call_args.kwargs["transformer_layer_spec"] is import_spec.return_value
+
+
+def test_liger_empty_decoder_stage_forwards_norms_to_mtp():
+    config = _config(use_liger=True, mtp_num_layers=1)
+    args = _args(mtp_num_layers=1)
+    block = TransformerBlockSubmodules(layer_specs=[], layer_norm=object)
+    with (
+        patch.object(gpt_builders, "GPTModel"),
+        patch.object(gpt_builders, "get_gpt_decoder_block_spec", return_value=block),
+        patch.object(gpt_builders, "get_gpt_layer_local_spec") as local_spec,
+        patch.object(gpt_builders, "get_gpt_mtp_block_spec") as mtp_spec,
+    ):
+        gpt_builders.gpt_builder(args, True, True, config=config)
+
+    assert local_spec.call_args.kwargs["use_liger"] is True
+    assert mtp_spec.call_args.args[1] is local_spec.return_value
